notes.title: Cashback Sale!
notes.content:
Winter is on its way out and it's time to prepare the shop for the influx of spring customers and spruce things up a bit.

If you're rarin' to expand now, we have good news for you:                              

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510958/9171ae379c1d994d6df2c3436585f1118a33d3e8.jpg[/img]

From [b]Thursday, February 15[/b], at [b]11:00 am[/b] until [b]Sunday, February 18[/b], at [b]11:59 pm[/b] CET, you'll have the chance to earn back [b]a percentage[/b] of the Diamonds you spend in the game. This is a great chance to save on fancy decorations, pens, equipment, staff and more! The more you spend, the more you save - you can get [b]up to 25% of the Diamonds[/b] you spend back!

[i]But it gets even better![/i]  At the 100 and 2000 thresholds, you'll also get a [b][color=#715E56]Bull Terrier[/b] on top of your Diamond reimbursement! 

The more Diamonds you spend, the more you'll get!

[list][i][b]0-100 Diamonds:[/b][/i] [b]5%[/b] of your Diamonds back
[i][b]100-500 Diamonds:[/b] [/i][b]10%[/b] of your Diamonds back + [b]1 Bull Terrier[/b]
[i][b]500-1000 Diamonds:[/b] [/i][b]15%[/b] of your Diamonds back 
[i][b]1000-2000 Diamonds:[/b][/i] [b]20%[/b] of your Diamonds back 
[i][b]2000+ Diamonds:[/b][/i] [b]25%[/b] of your Diamonds back +[b]1 Bull Terrier[/b][/list]

[i]The [b]card prizes are cumulative [/b]- that means if you spend 2000 Diamonds, you will get 500 Diamonds (25%) back and get a total of 2 Bull Terriers![/i]

Bull Terriers are stubborn clowns. They can be a bit obstinate but are loving family dogs. They will feel most comfortable in [i]upholstered, aspen bedding and straw enclosures[/i].

The Diamonds will be paid out upon logging in between [b]Monday, February 19, at 11:00 am[/b] and Monday, February 26, at 10:59 am CET.

In the game, you'll see a [b]symbol on the right side of the screen[/b] that will show when the event starts, and later, what you'll get back. During the weekend event, all premium expenditures will be logged there, and you'll be shown what you'll get on Monday.
